duplicate_remeasurements.note: the sequential runner and the parallelized workers overlapped on these questions; each duplicate is an INDEPENDENT re-measurement and reproduced the substrate verdict

db: dedicated falkordb-eval container (localhost:6380), one fresh graph namespace per question (probe2578w1_<qid>)

infra_incident.what: mid-wave throughput collapse: the client blocked indefinitely in a FalkorDB socket read (no timeout, no heartbeat, 0% CPU) while the extractor endpoint (1.0-1.2 s at a realistic payload) and isolated graph queries (0.07-0.68 ms) were both fast; the eval container was in a continuous active-defrag loop
infra_incident.mitigation: activedefrag disabled on the eval container; the wave-1 remainder was parallelised per question (independent graph namespaces) to bound wall-clock
